biggest_catch: Daily cashout costs $1.99 per transaction and is locked behind eligibility — you need 25 lifetime deliveries and 14 days on the platform before Fast Pay even opens.
catches: Fast Pay requires: 25+ lifetime deliveries, 14+ days active, debit card set up 7+ days with no changes. Until then it's weekly direct deposit only.
Fast Pay costs $1.99 per cashout, once per day.
New Dashers wait for a background check + activation before their first dash.
Your pay varies per offer (base + promotions + tips); DoorDash does not guarantee a per-order amount — every offer shows its guaranteed minimum before you accept.

steps: Sign up as a Dasher and pass the background check; activate.
Go online and accept offers — each shows its guaranteed minimum before you accept.
Complete deliveries; pay = base pay + promotions + 100% of tips.
Cash out daily with Fast Pay ($1.99, once/day, eligibility-gated) or get no-fee instant deposits after every dash with the DoorDash Crimson account.
Default weekly direct deposit is automatic if you don't cash out early.
timing: Fast Pay: daily cashout to your debit card ($1.99, once/day, 25-delivery/14-day eligibility). Crimson: no-fee instant deposit after every dash. Default: weekly direct deposit.
who_pays: DoorDash pays you per offer — base pay plus promotions plus 100% of tips; every offer shows its guaranteed minimum before you accept.
who_qualifies: 18+ (21 in CA); a background check; a vehicle or bike (select cities); a smartphone; a debit card for Fast Pay.
work_available: Open once you're activated — you dash when it's busy in your zone; offer volume varies by time and zone.
what_gets_accepted: Every offer shows its guaranteed minimum before you accept, and pay is per completed delivery — nothing is taken away after the fact.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: the background check and activation before your first dash, plus waiting between orders. Your vehicle costs are yours; Fast Pay costs $1.99 per cashout.
when_cash_arrives: Fast Pay: daily cashout to your debit card ($1.99, once a day) after 25 lifetime deliveries and 14 days active. DoorDash Crimson: no-fee instant deposit after every dash. Default: free weekly direct deposit.

repeatable.cadence: Dash whenever you want — each delivery earns, cash out daily with Fast Pay, and keep dashing.
